Hi Sarah — quick technical follow up / clarifications based on Marissa's notes and your asks. I'll keep this explicit so your procurement/security folks can map requirements to options.

SOC 2 / BAA
- We can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report (attached as SOC2_report_stub.txt). The report covers our hosted control plane and production inference runtime for the models we serve in the hosted offering.
- BAA: Redwood supports executing a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments today. For our hosted public API we can evaluate on an enterprise plan; reach out to sales/legal for specific language — we typically require Dedicated/Private for full HIPAA posture.

Deletion SLA (primary storage vs backups)
- Primary storage (user data / customer objects): deletion requests are processed immediately; removes the object from primary indexes and live storage within 24 hours in hosted routes.
- Backups / snapshots: hosted backups are on a snapshot schedule. We provide an operational deletion window of up to 90 days for complete removal from backup snapshots in hosted mode (this is our standard guarantee today).
- For customers requiring shorter backup-deletion windows (e.g., 30/60 days) or immediate removal from backups, we recommend Dedicated or Private where backup schedules/retention can be configured and contractual SLAs can be guaranteed.

Log retention and archival
- Default: access/event logs in hosted are retained 90 days (searchable in Console).
- Extended retention: we offer extended log retention via two options:
  * Export: automated export of logs to customer-owned S3 (or GCS) for cold storage (can meet multi-year retention requirements) — recommended and straightforward.
  * Dedicated/Private: configurable retention policies up to multi-year retention with support for customer-managed KMS and long-term archival. This is the common path for regulated customers that need 7-year retention.

Encryption / KMS
- Encryption in transit and at rest is standard. For backups and long-term archival we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted we offer provider-managed encryption and can discuss Bring-Your-Own-Key for enterprise contracts.

Next steps / questionnaire
- I'm happy to own the technical answers in the vendor questionnaire. I can have the first-pass completed within 3 business days once we have the specific sections flagged (e.g., PHI processing, backups, key management).
- I've uploaded a short technical appendix + the SOC 2 stub to the Drive link Marissa shared.

If you want to tighten any of the timelines (e.g., 5 business days for questionnaire completion), let me know and we'll prioritize.

Regards,
